title: SpecAgent: Empowering Program Verification with Agentic Synthesis of Formal Program Specifications
title_zh: SpecAgent：通过智能体合成形式化程序规范，赋能程序验证

paragraphs.en: Formal specifications are essential for deductive program verification, as they provide semantic abstractions that enable compositional verification on complex software systems. The difficulties in manually constructing such specifications gave birth to automated specification synthesis, and recent advances in relevant approaches based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promising capabilities. Nevertheless, existing approaches often follow a forward-only synthesis workflow and rely on localized repair strategies, which limit their effectiveness on real-world programs with complex dependencies among functions and loops. In such scenarios, verification failures may originate from previously generated specifications rather than the immediate failure locations, leading to cascading failures that cannot be effectively addressed by local refinement. In this paper, we present SpecAgent , an agentic framework for synthesizing high-quality ACSL specifications for real-world C programs. SpecAgent integrates four complementary components into a unified workflow: it analyzes program structures and dependencies to plan specification targets, leverages retrieval-augmented generation with a specification knowledge base to provide LLMs with relevant specification patterns and program context, employs agentic repairing to diagnose specification defects and revisit previously generated specifications when verification failures are traced to their dependencies, and applies an agentic critique mechanism to assess and refine semantic strength beyond proof success. We extensively evaluate SpecAgent on both specification synthesis and program verification tasks. On a benchmark consisting of 50 programs from 14 real-world repositories, SpecAgent with DeepSeek-V4 achieves 96.82% precision and 88.95% recall in synthesizing correct yet strong specifications, substantially outperforming all baselines including Codex equipped with GPT-5.6. We further evaluate SpecAgent on 811 real-world verification targets, where SpecAgent successfully discharges 604 targets, surpassing existing baselines. The results show that SpecAgent can effectively synthesize high-quality specifications and facilitate verification of real-world software.

paragraphs.en: Program verification ( Hoare, 1969 ) is an essential technique for software reliability assurance, which can provide rigorous guarantees by proving consistency between the target program and given properties (including functional correctness and runtime safety constraints), complementing conventional techniques such as software testing ( Howden, 1991 ) . However, automatically verifying complex programs against high-level properties is fundamentally challenging, as the general program verification problem is undecidable ( Mathur et al., 2019 ) due to the potential unbounded behaviors produced by intricate program structures such as loops and function calls. One typical approach to achieving deductive verification is based on auxiliary specifications ( Frade and Pinto, 2011 ) , which are expressed in parsable, unambiguous formal languages and can abstract the behaviors of individual program structures. Specifically, loop invariants summarize the properties preserved across loop iterations, while function contracts (typically including preconditions and postconditions) characterize the behavioral guarantees of function calls. These specifications provide the semantic abstractions needed by the verifier to construct local proof obligations and facilitate compositional proof construction, thereby enabling the verification of high-level target properties of the overall program ( Frade and Pinto, 2011 ; Henzinger et al., 1998 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 程序验证（Hoare，1969）是确保软件可靠性的关键技术，它通过证明目标程序与给定属性（包括功能正确性和运行时安全约束）之间的一致性来提供严格的保证，从而补充了软件测试（Howden，1991）等传统技术。 然而，自动验证复杂程序是否符合高级属性在根本上具有挑战性，因为由于循环和函数调用等复杂程序结构可能产生无界行为，一般的程序验证问题是不可判定的（Mathur 等人，2019）。 实现演绎验证的一种典型方法基于辅助规范（Frade 和 Pinto，2011），这些规范用可解析且无歧义的正式语言表达，能够抽象表示单个程序结构的行为。 具体而言，循环不变量总结了在循环迭代中保持不变的属性，而函数契约（通常包括前提条件和后置条件）则描述了函数调用的行为保证。 这些规范为验证器提供了构建局部证明义务所需的语义抽象，并促进了组合式证明的构建，从而使得对整体程序的高级目标属性的验证成为可能（Frade 和 Pinto，2011；Henzinger 等人，1998）。

paragraphs.en: However, manually crafting formal program specifications remains labor-intensive and expertise-demanding ( Schiller and Ernst, 2012 ; Snook, 2001 ) , particularly for real-world software with complicated control flows and intricate data dependencies. This challenge has motivated substantial research into automated specification synthesis. Early approaches in this direction typically rely on heuristic rules ( Flanagan and Leino, 2001 ; Ernst et al., 2007 ; Molina et al., 2022 ) or machine learning techniques ( Li et al., 2017 ; Si et al., 2018 ; Ryan et al., 2019 ) . Recently, large language models (LLMs) ( OpenAI, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026c ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) have demonstrated promising capabilities in program comprehension and code summarization, bringing new light on automated program specification synthesis. A series of LLM-based approaches ( Wen et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Pei et al., 2023 ; Cao et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) have been explored to generate function contracts and loop invariants, often in conjunction with formal verification tools to validate and refine the generated specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，手动编写正式的程序规范仍然是一项劳动密集型且需要专业知识的任务（Schiller 和 Ernst，2012；Snook，2001），尤其对于具有复杂控制流和错综数据依赖关系的现实世界软件而言。 这一挑战推动了自动化规范合成领域的广泛研究。 该方向早期的方法通常依赖于启发式规则（Flanagan 和 Leino，2001；Ernst 等，2007；Molina 等，2022）或机器学习技术（Li 等，2017；Si 等，2018；Ryan 等，2019）。 最近，大型语言模型（LLMs）（OpenAI，2026b；OpenAI，2026c；Grattafiori 等，2024；Liu 等，2024；Guo 等，2025；Xu 等，2026）在程序理解和代码摘要方面展现出令人期待的能力，为自动化程序规范合成带来了新的希望。 一系列基于大型语言模型的方法（Wen 等，2024；Ma 等，2024；Pei 等，2023；Cao 等，2025；Wang 等，2025b）已被探索用于生成函数契约和循环不变量，这些方法通常与形式化验证工具结合使用，以验证并完善生成的规范。

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, synthesizing high-quality specifications for complex real-world programs remains challenging due to fundamental limitations of existing approaches. First, they typically follow a forward-only workflow, in which a specification is considered finalized once successfully generated and is not revisited in subsequent stages. Second, their repair process is predominantly localized : when verification fails, they locate and repair errors solely based on the locations indicated by the verifier, without considering specifications at other program points. These design choices become problematic in complex real-world programs, where intricate dependencies widely exist among program structures including loops and function calls, and consequently among the specifications that abstract their behaviors. Due to these dependencies, verification failure in downstream specifications may stem from semantic correctness/strength issues in other upstream specifications on which they depend. Such issues can propagate along dependency chains, triggering cascading verification failures . However, the forward-only workflow prevents existing approaches from revisiting upstream specifications, while localized repair confines their efforts to the immediate failure site. Consequently, they may repeatedly attempt ineffective local repairs without addressing the root cause, compromising the correctness and strength of the synthesized specifications and ultimately limiting their ability to support the verification of target properties.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，但由于现有方法存在根本性局限，为复杂的现实世界程序合成高质量规格仍然具有挑战性。 首先，它们通常遵循单向工作流程：一旦规格成功生成，即被视为最终确定，在后续阶段不再重新审视。 其次，其修复过程主要是局部化的：当验证失败时，它们仅根据验证器指示的位置定位并修复错误，而不会考虑程序中其他位置的规格。 这些设计选择在复杂的现实世界程序中会变得有问题，因为程序结构（包括循环和函数调用）之间存在广泛的复杂依赖关系，进而导致抽象其行为的规格之间也存在依赖关系。 由于这些依赖关系，下游规格的验证失败可能源于其所依赖的其他上游规格在语义正确性或强度方面存在的问题。 此类问题可能沿着依赖链传播，引发连锁验证失败。 然而，单向工作流程使得现有方法无法重新审视上游规格，而局部化修复则将其努力限制在直接的失败位置。 因此，它们可能会反复尝试无效的局部修复，却无法解决根本原因，从而损害所合成规格的准确性和强度，最终限制其支持目标属性验证的能力。

paragraphs.en: Addressing this limitation presents several challenges. First, specification synthesis must account for dependencies induced by program structure. Real-world programs involve intricate relationships among functions, loops, and data structures, making it difficult to identify the specification synthesis order and the underlying specifications responsible for verification failures. Second, verification feedback does not directly identify the root causes of specification defects. A failed proof may result from an incorrect or insufficient specification, a runtime safety violation, or limitations of the underlying verification process. Distinguishing these causes and determining the appropriate scope of refinement require reasoning over both verification evidence and program context. Third, proof success alone is insufficient to establish specification quality. Weak or vacuous specifications may be readily verified while failing to capture meaningful program behavior or provide useful guarantees to callers. Therefore, an effective synthesis approach must not only produce verifiable specifications but also assess their semantic adequacy and refine them when necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 解决这一局限性存在若干挑战。 首先，规范合成必须考虑程序结构所引发的依赖关系。 现实中的程序涉及函数、循环和数据结构之间的复杂关系，这使得确定规范合成的顺序以及导致验证失败的底层规范变得困难。 其次，验证反馈并不会直接指出规范缺陷的根本原因。 证明失败可能源于规范不正确或不充分、运行时安全违规，或底层验证过程的局限性。 区分这些原因并确定适当的细化范围，需要对验证证据和程序上下文进行推理分析。 第三，仅凭证明成功不足以确立规范的质量。 弱或空洞的规范可能容易被验证，但却无法捕捉有意义的程序行为，也无法为调用者提供有用的保证。 因此，一种有效的合成方法不仅要生成可验证的规范，还必须评估其语义上的充分性，并在必要时对其进行细化。

sents.en: Addressing this limitation presents several challenges.
sents.zh: 解决这一局限性存在若干挑战。

sents.en: First, specification synthesis must account for dependencies induced by program structure.
sents.zh: 首先，规范合成必须考虑程序结构所引发的依赖关系。

sents.en: Real-world programs involve intricate relationships among functions, loops, and data structures, making it difficult to identify the specification synthesis order and the underlying specifications responsible for verification failures.
sents.zh: 现实中的程序涉及函数、循环和数据结构之间的复杂关系，这使得确定规范合成的顺序以及导致验证失败的底层规范变得困难。

sents.en: Second, verification feedback does not directly identify the root causes of specification defects.
sents.zh: 其次，验证反馈并不会直接指出规范缺陷的根本原因。

sents.en: A failed proof may result from an incorrect or insufficient specification, a runtime safety violation, or limitations of the underlying verification process.
sents.zh: 证明失败可能源于规范不正确或不充分、运行时安全违规，或底层验证过程的局限性。

sents.en: Distinguishing these causes and determining the appropriate scope of refinement require reasoning over both verification evidence and program context.
sents.zh: 区分这些原因并确定适当的细化范围，需要对验证证据和程序上下文进行推理分析。

sents.en: Third, proof success alone is insufficient to establish specification quality.
sents.zh: 第三，仅凭证明成功不足以确立规范的质量。

sents.en: Weak or vacuous specifications may be readily verified while failing to capture meaningful program behavior or provide useful guarantees to callers.
sents.zh: 弱或空洞的规范可能容易被验证，但却无法捕捉有意义的程序行为，也无法为调用者提供有用的保证。

sents.en: Therefore, an effective synthesis approach must not only produce verifiable specifications but also assess their semantic adequacy and refine them when necessary.
sents.zh: 因此，一种有效的合成方法不仅要生成可验证的规范，还必须评估其语义上的充分性，并在必要时对其进行细化。

paragraphs.en: These challenges call for a shift from localized specification generation and repair toward agentic specification synthesis , where specifications are generated and refined through agentic dependency-aware decision-making. Instead of treating generated specifications as immutable artifacts, such a process can trace root causes across specification dependencies, revisit and improve defective specifications, and ensure that the resulting specifications provide meaningful behavioral abstractions beyond merely passing verification. To realize this vision, we propose SpecAgent , an agentic framework for synthesizing formal specifications in ACSL for real-world C programs. SpecAgent first employs dependency-aware planning to identify specification targets and organize their synthesis according to program structure and verification objectives. It then leverages agentic generation, augmented with relevant specification knowledge and program context, to construct auxiliary specifications, which are subsequently checked by formal verification tools, guiding the system in diagnosing failures and determining appropriate repair actions. Unlike workflows restricted to localized repair, SpecAgent utilizes agentic repairing that can trace verification issues across program dependencies and revisit previously generated specifications when they are identified as potential root causes. In addition, a specification critique mechanism evaluates the semantic strength of verified specifications, helping identify cases in which proof success does not translate into sufficiently informative behavioral guarantees. By integrating these capabilities into a unified workflow, SpecAgent aims to improve both the correctness and quality of specifications while reducing the manual effort required for verifying real-world software.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SpecAgent through extensive experiments from two complementary perspectives: quality of synthesized specifications and ability to support program verification. For the specification synthesis task, we conduct experiments on a benchmark comprising 50 sizable programs from 14 real-world C repositories, where SpecAgent achieves 96.82% precision and 88.95% recall, substantially outperforming existing approaches (including Codex with gpt-5.6-sol ) in generating correct and sufficiently complete specifications. We further evaluate the ability of SpecAgent -generated specifications to support real-world verification tasks on 811 verification targets from two established benchmarks, covering both runtime-safety and reachability-oriented verification tasks. SpecAgent successfully discharges 604 out of 811 verification targets, substantially surpassing the best-performing existing baseline (yielding 523). These results provide empirical evidence that the specifications synthesized by SpecAgent are not only semantically accurate but also practically effective in facilitating the verification of high-level target properties.

paragraphs.en: Program verification ( Hoare, 1969 ) aims to establish whether a program satisfies desired properties, such as functional correctness and runtime safety constraints, by formally proving the consistency between program behaviors and given specifications. However, directly verifying high-level properties of complex programs is challenging due to the unbounded behaviors introduced by intricate control-flow structures, such as loops and function calls ( Mathur et al., 2019 ) . To enable effective verification, deductive verification commonly relies on auxiliary specifications ( Frade and Pinto, 2011 ) , which describe the behaviors of individual program structures in precise and unambiguous formal languages. These specifications serve as semantic abstractions that allow verifiers to encode program behaviors compositionally. For example, function contracts summarize the assumptions and guarantees of function invocations, while loop invariants characterize properties preserved across loop iterations. By providing such abstractions, auxiliary specifications enable verifiers to construct local verification obligations and combine them to establish the proof for high-level properties of the overall program.
paragraphs.zh: 程序验证（Hoare，1969）旨在通过形式化证明程序行为与给定规范之间的一致性，来确定一个程序是否满足期望的属性，例如功能正确性和运行时安全约束。 然而，由于复杂的控制流结构（如循环和函数调用）引入了无界行为，直接验证复杂程序的高层属性极具挑战性（Mathur 等，2019）。 为了实现有效验证，演绎验证通常依赖辅助规范（Frade 和 Pinto，2011），这些规范使用精确且无歧义的形式语言来描述单个程序结构的行为。 这些规范充当语义抽象，使验证器能够以组合方式编码程序行为。 例如，函数契约总结了函数调用的假设与保证，而循环不变量则描述了在循环迭代中保持不变的属性。 通过提供此类抽象，辅助规范使验证器能够构建局部验证义务，并将它们组合起来，从而为整个程序的高层属性建立证明。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we focus on the ANSI/ISO C Specification Language (ACSL) ( Baudin et al., 2008 ) , a formal specification language for annotating C programs. ACSL provides various constructs for describing program behaviors, among which function contracts and loop invariants are particularly important for deductive verification. Specifically, requires statements define preconditions that must hold before function execution, ensures statements specify postconditions guaranteed after execution, and loop invariant statements describe properties maintained throughout loop iterations. These annotations provide formal behavioral summaries of program structures, which can be leveraged by verification frameworks such as Frama-C/WP ( Baudin et al., ) to generate verification conditions and discharge them using automated theorem proving and SMT solving ( De Moura and Bjørner, 2008 ; Barrett et al., 2011 ; Conchon et al., 2018 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们专注于 ANSI/ISO C 规范语言（ACSL）（Baudin 等，2008），这是一种用于标注 C 程序的形式化规范语言。 ACSL 提供了多种描述程序行为的构造，其中函数契约和循环不变量对于演绎验证尤为重要。 具体而言，requires 语句定义了函数执行前必须满足的预条件，ensures 语句指定了执行后保证成立的术后条件，而循环不变量语句则描述了在整个循环迭代过程中保持不变的属性。 这些标注为程序结构提供了形式化的行为摘要，验证框架（如 Frama-C/WP）可以利用这些摘要生成验证条件，并通过自动定理证明和 SMT 求解（De Moura 和 Bjørner，2008；Barrett 等，2011；Conchon 等，2018）来验证这些条件。

paragraphs.en: Despite their importance, constructing effective auxiliary specifications remains challenging. Writing formal specifications requires developers to not only understand the intended behaviors of programs but also identify appropriate abstractions and express them in a rigorous formal language ( Schiller and Ernst, 2012 ) . For real-world software with entangled data dependencies and numerous interacting components, manually designing sufficiently precise specifications can be labor-intensive and error-prone. This has motivated extensive research on automated specification synthesis. Traditional specification synthesis approaches range from rule-based techniques ( Flanagan and Leino, 2001 ; Ernst et al., 2007 ; Molina et al., 2022 ) to learning-based methods ( Li et al., 2017 ; Si et al., 2018 ; Ryan et al., 2019 ) . More recently, the rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) ( OpenAI, 2026b ; Achiam et al., 2023 ; OpenAI, 2026c ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) has brought new opportunities for program specification generation by leveraging their strong capabilities in code understanding and summarization, giving rise to a series of LLM-based approaches ( Wen et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Real-world programs rarely consist of independent components. Functions interact through calls and shared data, data structures are constrained by the operations that manipulate them, and loops and their surrounding code jointly determine program states and invariants. Consequently, the specifications of individual program components are often semantically interdependent: a specification for one component often relies on preconditions, postconditions, invariants, or behavioral properties established by another. Effective specification synthesis therefore needs to account for such dependencies and propagate sufficient semantic information across them.
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界中的程序很少由相互独立的组件构成。 函数通过调用和共享数据进行交互，数据结构受到对其操作的限制，而循环及其周围的代码共同决定了程序的状态和不变量。 因此，单个程序组件的规范在语义上通常是相互依赖的：一个组件的规范往往依赖于另一个组件所确立的前置条件、后置条件、不变量或行为特性。 因此，有效的规范合成需要考虑到这些依赖关系，并在它们之间传播足够的语义信息。

sents.en: Effective specification synthesis therefore needs to account for such dependencies and propagate sufficient semantic information across them.
sents.zh: 因此，有效的规范合成需要考虑到这些依赖关系，并在它们之间传播足够的语义信息。

paragraphs.en: Existing specification synthesis approaches, such as Preguss ( Wang et al., 2025b ) and SpecSyn ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , have been aware of the phenomenon and choose to generate specifications incrementally according to the dependency relations among program components. Nevertheless, they largely follow a forward-only process: once a specification has been generated and satisfies the verification checks available at that stage, it is typically treated as finalized and will never be revisited. This creates a potential problem when an upstream specification is locally acceptable but insufficiently strong for its downstream dependents. For example, as illustrated in Figure 1 , a weak but verifiable postcondition S1 (line 1) may provide insufficient semantic information for synthesizing S2 (line 4), causing semantic validity issues in the latter as well. The resulting deficiency can thus propagate along the specification dependency chain and eventually manifest as verification failures of the target properties.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的规范合成方法，例如 Preguss（Wang 等人，2025b）和 SpecSyn（Ma 等人，2026），已经意识到这一现象，并选择根据程序组件之间的依赖关系逐步生成规范。 然而，这些方法在很大程度上遵循一个仅向前推进的过程：一旦某个规范被生成并通过该阶段可用的验证检查，它通常就被视为最终确定，且永远不会被重新审视。 当上游规范在局部上是可接受的，但对于其下游依赖项而言强度不足时，这就会造成潜在问题。 例如，如图 1 所示，一个较弱但可验证的后置条件 S1（第 1 行）可能无法为合成 S2（第 4 行）提供足够的语义信息，从而导致后者也出现语义有效性问题。 因此，由此产生的缺陷可能会沿着规范依赖链传播，并最终表现为目标属性的验证失败。

paragraphs.en: Confronted with such downstream failures, existing approaches typically rely on localized repair, i,e., modifying the specification at or around the observed failure location, since they are typically forward-only and cannot revisit finalized specifications. However, the observed failure does not necessarily indicate the actual location of the underlying defect. In the example above, repeatedly repairing S2 cannot resolve a deficiency originating from the already-finalized S1 . The synthesis process may therefore become trapped in a failure loop: downstream failures trigger repeated local repairs while the upstream root cause remains untouched, and the verification feedback obtained at later stages cannot be utilized to revise earlier synthesis decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 面对此类下游故障，现有方法通常依赖局部修复，即修改已观察到的故障位置处或附近的规范，因为这些方法通常是单向推进的，无法重新审视已最终确定的规范。 然而，观察到的故障并不一定表明潜在缺陷的实际位置。 在上面的例子中，重复修复 S2 无法解决源于已最终确定的 S1 的问题。 因此，合成过程可能会陷入故障循环：下游故障会触发反复的局部修复，而上游的根本原因却未被处理，后期获得的验证反馈也无法用于修正早期的合成决策。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by these observations, we aim to propose an agentic specification synthesis paradigm, where specification synthesis is treated as an iterative decision-making process rather than a strictly forward, one-pass pipeline. Unlike conventional approaches that finalize a specification once its processing is complete, an agent can continuously reason over the evolving set of specifications and the verification feedback obtained from downstream components. When a downstream failure suggests that an upstream specification may be insufficient, the agent can trace the specification dependencies, revisit the previously generated specification, refine it, and propagate the resulting changes to its dependents. In this sense, agentic synthesis naturally tackles the aforementioned deficiency propagation problem by enabling the agent to reconsider its previous decisions in light of newly acquired evidence and iteratively improve the specification set.
paragraphs.zh: 受这些观察结果的启发，我们旨在提出一种智能体驱动的规范合成范式，其中规范合成被视为一个迭代决策过程，而非严格的前向单通管道。 与那些在规范处理完成后即最终确定规范的常规方法不同，智能体能够持续对不断演变的规范集合以及从下游组件获得的验证反馈进行推理。 当下游故障表明上游规范可能不足时，智能体可以追溯规范依赖关系，重新审视先前生成的规范，对其进行优化，并将由此产生的变更传播至其依赖项。 从这个意义上说，智能体驱动的规范合成通过使智能体能够根据新获取的证据重新评估先前的决策并迭代改进规范集合，自然地解决了前述缺陷传播问题。

paragraphs.en: Overview. SpecAgent consists of four successive stages, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Given a target C program, the Planning Agent first identifies required specifications, their semantics, and dependencies. The Generation Agent then constructs ACSL annotations with support from structurally relevant examples retrieved from a dedicated knowledge base. Generated candidates are checked by Frama-C/WP, and failed candidates are diagnosed and repaired by the Repairing Agent until they pass verification. Verified specifications are further assessed by the Critique Agent, which triggers refinement when insufficient properties are identified. Through collaboration among specialized agents, SpecAgent enables flexible specification synthesis by leveraging evolving contextual information and external verification feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 概述。 如 Fig. 2 所示，SpecAgent 由四个连续阶段组成。 给定一个目标 C 程序，规划智能体首先确定所需的规范、其语义和依赖关系。 随后，生成智能体借助从专用知识库中检索到的结构相关示例来构建 ACSL 注释。 生成的候选项由 Frama-C/WP 进行检查，未通过验证的候选项则由修复智能体进行诊断和修复，直至通过验证。 经过验证的规范还会由评估智能体进一步审查；若发现属性不足，该智能体将触发优化过程。 通过各专用智能体的协作，SpecAgent 能够利用不断变化的上下文信息和外部验证反馈，实现灵活的规范合成。

paragraphs.en: Directly generating complete specifications requires an LLM to simultaneously identify relevant program properties, determine their dependencies, and express them in ACSL. Such responsibilities can become entangled for complex real-world programs, necessitating an explicit planning stage that separates specification-level reasoning from specific annotation construction. To this end, the planning Agent is designed to determine what should be specified and where to specify them before concrete ACSL annotations are generated.
paragraphs.zh: 直接生成完整的规范需要大型语言模型（LLM）同时识别程序的相关属性、确定其依赖关系，并以 ACSL 表达这些属性。 对于复杂的现实世界程序而言，这类职责可能会相互交织，因此需要一个显式的规划阶段，将规范层面的推理与具体的注释构建分离开来。 为此，规划智能体被设计用于在生成具体的 ACSL 注释之前，确定哪些内容需要被规范以及应在何处进行规范。

paragraphs.en: Upon receiving the target C program, SpecAgent uses syntax analysis to summarize relevant structural information into a deterministic program context, including function signatures, caller-callee relations, and loop statement positions, before invoking the planning agent. Based on this context and direct inspection of the source code, the planning agent identifies the functions and loops that require specification instrumentation and determines the properties that should be addressed, including functional contracts and runtime safety constraints, according to the target code snippets and relevant caller/callee context. The output of the Planning Agent is a specification synthesis plan in natural language. The plan describes the intended specification targets, their designed semantics, interdependencies, and processing order. It therefore serves as an intermediate reasoning artifact for subsequent processes.
paragraphs.zh: 在接收到目标 C 程序后，SpecAgent 会先通过语法分析将相关结构信息总结为确定性程序上下文，包括函数签名、调用者-被调用者关系以及循环语句的位置，然后再调用规划智能体。 基于该上下文以及对源代码的直接检查，规划智能体会识别出需要添加规格说明插装的函数和循环，并根据目标代码片段及相关调用者/被调用者上下文，确定需要处理的属性，包括功能契约和运行时安全约束。 规划智能体的输出是一个用自然语言编写的规格说明合成计划。 该计划描述了预期的规格说明目标、其设计的语义、相互依赖关系以及处理顺序。 因此，它可作为后续流程的中间推理产物。

sents.en: It therefore serves as an intermediate reasoning artifact for subsequent processes.
sents.zh: 因此，它可作为后续流程的中间推理产物。

paragraphs.en: After the planning stage, SpecAgent transforms the specification synthesis plan into concrete ACSL specifications by employing the Generation Agent . Given the target program and the current planning context, the Generation Agent constructs specifications for relevant functions and loops, including preconditions ( requires ), postconditions ( ensures ), frame conditions ( assigns ), loop invariants, and predicates when necessary. The generated annotations are intended to capture the behavioral and safety properties identified during the planning stage. The Generation Agent can perform search-and-replace edits ( Gauthier and others, 2024 ) to instrument candidate specifications into the target code, but is constrained by the framework to specification-level modification: the agent is only allowed to add or modify ACSL annotations, without permission to modify any code implementation itself, therefore preserving the implementation semantics of the input program. The instrumented candidate specifications are then deterministically checked for syntactic validity and conformance to ACSL standards by invoking the Frama-C tool.
paragraphs.zh: 在规划阶段结束后，SpecAgent 通过调用生成智能体，将规范合成计划转化为具体的 ACSL 规范。 给定目标程序和当前的规划上下文，生成智能体会为相关函数和循环构建规范，包括前提条件（requires）、后件条件（ensures）、框架条件（assigns）、循环不变量以及在必要时使用的谓词。 生成的注释旨在捕捉规划阶段所识别的行为和安全属性。 生成智能体可以执行查找替换编辑（Gauthier 等人，2024），将候选规范注入目标代码，但受框架限制，只能进行规范级别的修改：该智能体仅被允许添加或修改 ACSL 注释，无权修改任何代码实现本身，从而保留了输入程序的实现语义。 随后，通过调用 Frama-C 工具，对注入后的候选规范进行确定性检查，验证其语法有效性以及对 ACSL 标准的符合性。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge Collection. To obtain specification examples grounded in reliable ACSL usage, we construct a dedicated knowledge base from the official ACSL tutorial ( Baudin et al., ) . We first collect the annotated C code snippets distributed throughout the tutorial and organize them into function-level knowledge units, yielding 184 units in total. Each unit consists of a C function together with annotated specifications, preserving the original consistency between code and specification.
paragraphs.zh: 知识收集。 为了获得基于可靠 ACSL 使用的规范示例，我们从官方 ACSL 教程（Baudin et al., ）中构建了一个专门的知识库。 我们首先收集了教程中各处分布的带注释的 C 代码片段，并将其组织为函数级的知识单元，总共得到 184 个单元。 每个单元由一个 C 函数及其带注释的规范组成，从而保留了代码与规范之间的原始一致性。

paragraphs.en: Structural Fingerprint of Knowledge Units. For each knowledge unit, we perform syntax analysis and regex matching to extract the program’s structural features. The extracted information covers a wide spectrum of aspects, including parameter types, pointer and array usage, branch and loop statements, memory accesses, function calls, return value types, and complex ACSL constructs involved. These features provide a structural description of each example and are later used to identify examples structurally compatible with the target code given. To enable efficient structural matching during retrieval, we further encode the extracted features into a compact 32-bit bitvector representation, referred to as the structural fingerprint . Figure 3 details the complete encoding scheme. Each bit corresponds to an aforementioned structural feature and is set when the corresponding property is present in the code snippet. The reserved bits are kept to 0 under our settings. The bitwise fingerprint enables efficient computation of the structural overlap between a target function and knowledge units.

paragraphs.en: Knowledge Retrieval Based on Structural Similarity. Given a target function, SpecAgent retrieves annotated code snippets from the knowledge base according to their structural similarity to the target. The retrieval process uses a two-stage filtering and ranking procedure, progressively narrowing the candidate space from coarse structural compatibility to fine-grained similarity. This design allows the retrieved examples to share critical program characteristics with the target while avoiding unnecessary comparisons against structurally unrelated functions.
paragraphs.zh: 基于结构相似性的知识检索。 给定一个目标函数，SpecAgent 会根据其与目标函数的结构相似性，从知识库中检索已标注的代码片段。 该检索过程采用两阶段过滤与排序机制，逐步将候选范围从粗略的结构兼容性缩小到精细的相似性匹配。 这种设计使得检索到的示例能够与目标函数共享关键程序特性，同时避免与结构无关的函数进行不必要的比较。

paragraphs.en: Specification synthesis is not necessarily a one-shot process, since LLM-generated specifications can be incomplete or incorrect, hindering their ability to support program verification. In SpecAgent , each synthesized specification is subjected to a verification gate before being committed to the final set of output specifications. The verification gate encapsulates Frama-C/WP ( Baudin et al., ) , the verifier for ACSL, able to determine whether the candidate is syntactically valid, successfully parsed, and verifiable by the underlying verification tool. It also categorizes verification goals and outcomes reported by Frama-C/WP, including successes, syntax errors, proof failures, and timeouts, into a structured report in JSON representation, providing concrete evidence for subsequent repair. In particular, for each failure reported by the verifier, the gate maps the failure back to the source code, recovers the failure context including caller, callee, and exact source line, and reports them to the agent in detail. This turns opaque verifier-produced information into provenance-aware repair evidence, alleviating the agent’s burden concerning error comprehension and root-cause reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 规范合成并不一定是一次性完成的过程，因为大型语言模型生成的规范可能不完整或不正确，从而阻碍其支持程序验证的能力。 在 SpecAgent 中，每个合成的规范在加入最终输出规范集之前，都会经过一个验证关卡的检验。 该验证关卡封装了 Frama-C/WP（Baudin 等，），即 ACSL 的验证器，能够判断候选规范是否在语法上有效、能否成功解析，以及是否可由底层的验证工具进行验证。 它还将 Frama-C/WP 报告的验证目标和结果（包括成功、语法错误、证明失败和超时）分类整理为结构化的 JSON 格式报告，为后续修复提供具体证据。 特别地，对于验证器报告的每次失败，该关卡会将失败定位回源代码，恢复失败上下文信息（包括调用者、被调用者和确切的源代码行），并详细报告给智能体。 这将验证器生成的不透明信息转化为具备来源追溯能力的修复证据，减轻了智能体在理解错误和推理根本原因方面的负担。

paragraphs.en: When verification fails, a Repairing Agent is invoked to diagnose and repair the current set of candidate specifications. Given the source code and the verification report produced by the verification gate, the agent reasons about the root cause of failure and performs corresponding repair through search-and-replace edits. Typical repairs include rectifying specifications with syntax errors or non-conformance to ACSL standards, correcting inconsistent specification semantics with the target program, and strengthening the upstream specifications with weak semantic validity. During diagnosis, the agent can also invoke Frama-C/WP and Frama-C/Eva ( Bühler et al., ) to obtain additional verification and value-analysis evidence, facilitating the root-cause reasoning process. After the repairing agent finishes its job, the modified candidate is submitted to the Verification Gate again. This process iterates until the candidate passes the gate or the invocation budget for the repairing agent runs out, ensuring that all committed specifications have undergone a rigorous verification process to guarantee their correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 当验证失败时，会调用一个修复智能体来诊断并修复当前的候选规格集。 基于源代码和验证门生成的验证报告，该智能体会推理出故障的根本原因，并通过搜索替换编辑执行相应的修复。 典型的修复包括修正具有语法错误或不符合 ACSL 标准的规格、纠正与目标程序不一致的规格语义，以及通过较弱的语义有效性来加强上游规格。 在诊断过程中，该智能体还可以调用 Frama-C/WP 和 Frama-C/Eva（Bühler 等，），以获取额外的验证和值分析证据，从而促进根本原因推理过程。 修复智能体完成工作后，修改后的候选项会被再次提交给验证门。 该过程将持续迭代，直到候选项通过验证门或修复智能体的调用预算用尽，以确保所有已提交的规格都经过了严格的验证流程，以保障其正确性。

paragraphs.en: Relying solely on LLM-based reasoning to assess whether a specification sufficiently constrains program behavior can lead to inconsistent judgments. To support the Critique Agent in assessing specification strength, we introduce the Postcondition Completeness Probe as a static analysis tool that provides stable evidence to facilitate the agent’s judgment. The majority of existing approaches for specification completeness measurement are conducted through input-output pair modification ( Misu et al., 2026 ) or non-equivalent program mutation ( Le-Cong et al., 2025 ; Endres et al., 2024 ) , which heavily rely on the availability of representative test suites or dedicated mutation operators. Instead, we exploit a method based on the over-approximation feature of specifications ( Silveira and Ferreira, ) .
paragraphs.zh: 仅依赖基于大型语言模型（LLM）的推理来评估规范是否充分约束了程序行为，可能会导致判断不一致。 为了支持批判智能体对规范强度的评估，我们引入了“后置条件完整性探测”这一静态分析工具，以提供稳定的证据来辅助智能体的判断。 现有的大多数规范完整性测量方法都通过输入输出对的修改（Misu 等人，2026）或非等价程序变异（Le-Cong 等人，2025；Endres 等人，2024）来实现，这些方法严重依赖代表性测试用例集或专用变异算子的可用性。 相反，我们采用了一种基于规范过度近似特性的方法（Silveira 和 Ferreira，）。

paragraphs.en: The strength of a postcondition can be understood from the set of behaviors that it permits. Given a program f f with input space ℐ \mathcal{I} , let ℬ f = { ( i , o ) ∣ o = f ( i ) , i ∈ ℐ } \mathcal{B}_{f}=\{(i,o)\mid o=f(i),i\in\mathcal{I}\} denote its behavior set , where i i denotes the input program state and o o denotes the observable outcome, respectively. Given a set of postconditions S S , we similarly define its permitted behavior set as ℬ S = { ( i , o ) ∣ S ⁡ ( i , o ) = 𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐞 } \mathcal{B}_{S}=\{(i,o)\mid S(i,o)=\mathbf{true}\} , i.e., input-output pairs that satisfy S S . A correct postcondition must admit all behaviors of the implementation, i.e., ℬ f ⊆ ℬ S . \mathcal{B}_{f}\subseteq\mathcal{B}_{S}. Since S S may permit behaviors that are not actually exhibited by f f , ℬ S \mathcal{B}_{S} is an over-approximation of ℬ f \mathcal{B}_{f} . A stronger postcondition constrains this over-approximation more tightly by excluding behaviors that are not permitted by the specification. In the ideal case, S S precisely characterizes the function behavior ( ℬ f = ℬ S \mathcal{B}_{f}=\mathcal{B}_{S} ), yielding the strongest postconditions . In this case, because a deterministic function f f maps each admissible input to a unique output, such a postcondition also uniquely determines the output for every admissible input.

paragraphs.en: Unlike prior works ( Silveira and Ferreira, ; Zhang and Zhai, 2026 ; Misu et al., 2026 ; Le-Cong et al., 2025 ; Endres et al., 2024 ) that primarily stop upon a mere strength assessment result, our probe is further integrated into the agent’s iterative synthesis process through counterexample-guided refinement. paragraphs.en: Agent Behavioral Paradigm. All agents in SpecAgent operate under the ReAct paradigm ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . Specifically, each agent iteratively performs the thought-action-observation loop: in each iteration, it reasons over the currently available information, selects an appropriate action (typically a tool call), observes its outcome, and uses the obtained feedback to determine the next action. This design allows the agents to adapt their behavior (e.g., decide where to instrument specifications and what to specify) to intermediate status and results, rather than following a predefined sequential procedure (which is the common practice of existing approaches ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wen et al., 2024 ) ). The loop terminates when the agent determines that the overall objective assigned to it has been satisfied.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体行为范式。 SpecAgent 中的所有智能体均基于 ReAct 范式运行（Yao 等，2022）。 具体而言，每个智能体都会迭代执行“思考-行动-观察”循环：在每次迭代中，它会对当前可用的信息进行推理，选择一个适当的行动（通常是工具调用），观察其结果，并利用获得的反馈来决定下一步行动。 这种设计使智能体能够根据中间状态和结果调整其行为（例如，决定在何处植入规范以及规范什么内容），而不是遵循预定义的顺序流程（这是现有方法（Ma 等，2026；Wang 等，2025b；Wen 等，2024）的常见做法）。 当智能体判断其被赋予的总体目标已达成时，该循环即终止。

paragraphs.en: Agent Orchestrator. The agents are coordinated by a centralized orchestrator rather than agent-authored control flow to ensure the reliability of the overall framework. The orchestrator manages the workflow progress and agent invocations through a deterministic state machine following the logic shown in Fig. 2 . Agents therefore operate within explicitly defined roles and responsibilities, without the capability to directly interfere with the overall workflow. The orchestrator is also responsible for controlling the computational budget. Each agent invocation is subject to a predefined maximum number of iterations N s ​ t ​ e ​ p N_{step} , beyond which the invocation is forcibly terminated. Also, the framework will be enforced to terminate and output current intermediate candidates as final results after the total number of agent invocations reaches a predefined parameter N i ​ n ​ v ​ o ​ k ​ e N_{invoke} .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体协调器。 智能体由一个集中式协调器进行协调，而非由智能体自身编写控制流，以确保整个框架的可靠性。 协调器通过一个确定性状态机管理工作流程的进展和智能体的调用，该状态机遵循图 2 所示的逻辑。 因此，智能体在明确定义的角色和责任范围内运行，无法直接干预整体工作流程。 协调器还负责控制计算预算。 每次智能体调用都受到一个预定义的迭代次数上限 N_{step} 的限制，超过该上限则强制终止调用。 此外，当智能体总调用次数达到预定义参数 N_{invoke} 时，框架将被强制终止，并将当前的中间候选结果作为最终结果输出。

paragraphs.en: Inter-agent Communication. SpecAgent sets explicit memory boundaries between agent invocations, sharing no mutable runtime state or conversation history. Instead, agents communicate exclusively through a shared workspace. Each agent invocation can access the workspace, including current specifications, verification results, and documents produced by other agents, and can in turn update relevant workspace contents that serve as inputs to subsequent agents. Consequently, agent collaboration is achieved through successive operations on this shared intermediate context.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体间通信。 SpecAgent 在每次智能体调用之间设定明确的内存边界，不共享任何可变的运行时状态或对话历史。 相反，智能体仅通过一个共享工作区进行通信。 每次智能体调用都可以访问该工作区，包括当前规范、验证结果以及由其他智能体生成的文档，并可以反过来更新相关的工作区内容，这些内容将作为后续智能体的输入。 因此，智能体之间的协作是通过对这个共享的中间上下文进行连续操作来实现的。

paragraphs.en: We aim to answer the following research questions (RQs) through experiments:
paragraphs.zh: 我们旨在通过实验回答以下研究问题（RQs）：

paragraphs.en: Following the settings of prior works ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Zhang and Zhai, 2026 ) , we adopt two distinct metrics: precision and recall to comprehensively evaluate different aspects of specification quality. Precision measures the correctness of the generated specifications, calculated as the percentage of correct specifications over all generated specifications. Recall assesses the strength of the generated specifications, measured by the percentage of ground-truth specifications covered (i.e., there exists one generated specification that is as strong as this ground-truth) over all ground-truth specifications. We inherit the script utilized by Ma et al. ( Ma et al., 2026 ) for metric calculation, which identifies equivalence between ground-truth and generated specifications by constructing a conjunctive specification that connects the two specifications with a bidirectional implication operator and verifying its correctness with Frama-C/WP. Similar practices are widely adopted in existing works ( Silveira and Ferreira, ; Zhang and Zhai, 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Trade-off between Correctness and Strength. The results further reveal a clear trade-off faced by existing methods. AutoSpec and Preguss, for example, often achieve high precision on individual repositories, but their recalls remain low, with average recall as low as 20.26% and 28.22% under DeepSeek-V4, respectively. This suggests that their high precision is frequently accompanied by limited specification coverage. In contrast, SpecAgent maintains precision above 96% while reaching nearly 89% recall with DeepSeek-V4. This trend is even more clearly illustrated in Fig. 4 . Across all baselines, the majority of data points lie in the upper region of the grid, indicating that existing approaches generally achieve high precision. However, the points of Preguss and AutoSpec are predominantly concentrated toward the upper-left corner, whereas those of SpecAgent are substantially more clustered around the upper-right corner, highlighting the pronounced gap in recall across different approaches. This result is particularly notable because attempting to enhance specification strength introduces additional risk of incorrect or unverifiable assertions. The ability of SpecAgent to improve recall without a corresponding substantial loss in precision suggests that its agentic synthesis process can exploit verification feedback to effectively enrich specification semantics while preserving correctness.

paragraphs.en: Robustness across repositories. SpecAgent also demonstrates relatively stable performance across projects with substantially different program sizes. The benchmark ranges from relatively small programs such as those from X509-parser (95 LoC per file) to substantially larger ones such as UAV (1,741 LoC) and hypatia (1,323 LoC). Despite this variation, SpecAgent maintains precision close to or above 90% on most repositories and achieves high recall on both small and large programs. For example, on UAV, the largest repository in the benchmark, SpecAgent obtains 89.14% precision and 98.37% recall with DeepSeek-V4, and 76.95% precision and 88.58% recall with GPT-5. This suggests that the approach is not limited to short or structurally simple programs and can retain substantial specification strength as program complexity increases.

paragraphs.en: Effect of the Underlying LLM. Changing the underlying LLM affects the absolute performance of all approaches, but does not alter the relative advantage of SpecAgent . Replacing DeepSeek-V4 with GPT-5 slightly decreases average recall of SpecAgent from 88.95% to 82.77%, while precision remains comparably high (96.82% vs. 96.10%). In contrast, several baselines exhibit much larger degradations in recall when switching models. e.g., SpecGen from 74.47% to 60.23%. It is noteworthy that recall of Codex drops from 82.42% to 68.05% (-16.37%), whereas SpecAgent ’s recall decreases by only 6.18%, despite both Codex and SpecAgent adopting agentic workflows. This comparison suggests that SpecAgent ’s explicit verification-guided state transitions and iterative refinement make specification synthesis less sensitive to the underlying LLM’s agentic capabilities.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports the ablation results on DeepSeek-V4 and GPT-5. Overall, the results show that the individual components provide complementary benefits, while their combination is essential for achieving consistently strong performance. Using Generation alone (G only) already achieves relatively high precision, with average precision of 89.78% and 88.66% for DeepSeek-V4 and GPT-5, respectively, but its recall remains limited to 80.93% and 72.14%. Adding Planning (P+G) does not yield a consistent improvement: although recall increases slightly for DeepSeek-V4 to 83.99%, it slightly decreases for GPT-5 to 71.51%, suggesting that planning alone cannot reliably address synthesis failures. In contrast, incorporating Repairing (P+G+R) substantially improves precision, reaching 94.79% and 94.34% on average for DeepSeek-V4 and GPT-5, respectively, while also recovering recall to 82.08% and 76.21%. Finally, the complete SpecAgent configuration achieves the strongest overall performance, with average precision/recall of 96.82%/88.95% for DeepSeek-V4 and 96.10%/82.77% for GPT-5. Notably, the gain in recall over Generation-only is particularly pronounced for SpecAgent , reaching +8.02% and +10.63% for DeepSeek-V4 and GPT-5, respectively. These results indicate that the key advantage of SpecAgent does not stem from any single component, but from their interaction: Planning provides dependency-aware guidance, Repairing resolves invalid or unverifiable specifications, and the complete workflow enables these decisions to be iteratively informed by verification feedback.

paragraphs.en: To investigate how specification quality evolves as agent interactions accumulate, we analyze all specification evolution trajectories at increasing numbers of agent invocations. Specifically, we vary the number of agent invocations from 2 to 10 (1 excluded since the generation stage has not yet begun) and track four metrics at each invocation count: the fraction of trajectories that have passed the verification gate, the average number of generated specifications, precision, and recall. The first metric captures how quickly trajectories reach a verification-accepted state, while the latter three characterize the quantity and quality of the resulting specifications. This analysis allows us to examine how additional agent interactions contribute to specification synthesis and whether their benefits diminish as the invocation count increases.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 demonstrates the trend of candidate specification quality evolution as the number of agent invocations increases. As the number of agent invocations increases, candidate specification quality generally improves, but the gains gradually diminish. The most substantial improvement occurs in the early invocations: from 2 to 6 invocations, the mean precision increases from 93.11% to 96.32%, while the mean recall rises from 87.22% to 90.01%. Meanwhile, the average number of generated specifications increases from 79.79 to 90.70, indicating that additional agent interactions progressively expand the set of candidate specifications while maintaining or improving their quality. Most notably, the fraction of trajectories passing the verification gate also increases from 36% at 2 invocations to 62% at 6 invocations, suggesting that 2–6 is the golden interval where the majority of trajectories reach verifiable states. Beyond 6–8 invocations, however, the improvements become marginal: precision remains around 97%, recall fluctuates around 90%, and the verification-gate pass rate oscillates between 60% and 64%. These results suggest that agentic specification synthesis benefits substantially from a limited number of iterative interactions, after which additional invocations yield diminishing returns rather than continuously improving specification quality. This diminishing-return trend also justifies our choice of 10 as the maximum agent invocation budget, as further interactions are unlikely to yield substantial improvements in specification quality.

The programs are extracted from real-world repositories, with ACSL assertions on runtime error (RTE) freeness instrumented as verification targets. For these programs, SpecAgent consistently enables the successful verification of a large fraction of the target properties. Notably, on X509-parser, SpecAgent successfully discharges all 140 targets, compared with 128 and 126 for Preguss and SpecSyn, respectively. On Contiki, SpecAgent verifies 137 out of 163 targets, again exceeding Preguss (133) and SpecSyn (92). On the more challenging Atomthreads project, SpecAgent successfully verifies 109 of 239 targets, slightly below Preguss (112) but above SpecSyn (85), AutoSpec (99), and Codex (101). This is primarily due to its generation strategy, which requires the LLM to reproduce the input program while inserting ACSL annotations into the output, introducing the risk of unintended source-code modifications. paragraphs.en: SV-COMP. The programs retrieved from the SV-COMP benchmark are mainly toy examples (average LoC being 27.79), on which the verification tasks primarily focus on the synthesis of loop invariants. paragraphs.en: We further analyze the computational and monetary overhead of the evaluated approaches in terms of wall-clock time, Frama-C invocations, LLM calls, and API cost. As shown in Table 5 , SpecAgent requires 1,684.49 seconds and 25.58 Frama-C calls per program, far more efficient than verification-intensive approaches (Preguss and SpecSyn). Although the wall-time overhead over lightweight approaches (AutoSpec and SpecGen) is non-negligible, it remains substantially lower than the human effort required for real-world verification projects (e.g., developing ACSL specifications and completing the verification of X509-parser required five calendar months of manual effort ( Ebalard et al., 2019 ) ). Moreover, SpecAgent requires 99.40 LLM calls, slightly fewer than Preguss (107.30), with monetary cost being $0.6228, lower than Preguss ($0.7210) and Codex ($0.7100) while comparable to SpecSyn ($0.6243). Among the baselines, AutoSpec achieves the lowest overhead across all metrics. However, this efficiency is accompanied by substantially weaker effectiveness in specification generation and program verification. SpecGen also maintains low computational overhead but exhibits high instability on verification tasks (Section 5.4 ). In contrast, Preguss and SpecSyn incur considerably higher verification overhead, with 351.22 and 369.33 Frama-C calls, respectively, resulting in substantially longer wall time as well. Overall, SpecAgent achieves a practical balance between verification effectiveness and resource consumption, introducing moderate overhead to enable dependency-aware, verification-guided, and iterative specification synthesis.

paragraphs.en: Internal Threats. First, LLM-based agents may produce different outputs across runs due to the stochastic nature of generation, introducing potential variance into specification qualities. We mitigate this threat by fixing the model configurations across experiments and reporting aggregate results over a series of evaluated tasks. Second, our ablation study incrementally adds major components to the basic candidate-generation workflow, but adding a component may also change the subsequent execution trajectory and the number of agent interactions, making it difficult to completely isolate its individual contribution. We therefore interpret the ablation results as measuring the contribution of each component within the overall workflow rather than as strictly independent causal effects. Finally, the effectiveness of SpecAgent may be sensitive to agent budget configurations, e.g., the maximum number of agent invocations. Concerning this threat, our additional study on specification quality evolution shows that specification quality improves noticeably within the first 6–8 agent invocations, after which it tends to plateau, indicating that insufficient budgets can noticeably degrade specification quality, while larger budgets yield diminishing returns. The analysis provides empirical insights into the sensitivity of SpecAgent to agent budget and how to configure the budget in practical scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 内部威胁。 首先，由于生成过程的随机性，基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体在不同运行中可能产生不同的输出，从而给规范质量带来潜在的变异性。 通过在所有实验中固定模型配置，并对一系列评估任务报告汇总结果，我们缓解了这种威胁。 其次，我们的消融研究逐步向基础候选生成流程中添加主要组件，但添加某个组件也可能改变后续的执行路径以及智能体交互的次数，这使得完全孤立其单独贡献变得困难。 因此，我们将消融研究的解释视为衡量各组件在整个工作流程中的贡献，而非严格独立的因果效应。 最后，SpecAgent 的有效性可能对智能体预算配置（例如，智能体调用的最大次数）较为敏感。 针对这一威胁，我们对规范质量演变的补充研究表明：规范质量在前 6–8 次智能体调用内显著提升，之后则趋于平稳。这表明预算不足会明显降低规范质量，而更高的预算则会产生边际效益递减的效果。 该分析为 SpecAgent 对智能体预算的敏感度以及在实际场景中如何配置预算提供了经验性见解。

paragraphs.en: External Threats. The main external threat lies in the benchmark adopted for experiments. Although the benchmark programs come from real-world open-source repositories, the number of programs in the adopted benchmark is still limited. We mitigate this threat by evaluating the baselines across multiple repositories and complementing the experiments with real-world verification tasks. Further evaluation on larger and more diverse software systems is left for future work. Another threat concerns the language scope, as our evaluation focuses on C programs specified in ACSL and verified with the Frama-C/WP ecosystem. The effectiveness of the proposed agentic workflow may depend on the characteristics of this programming language and formal verification ecosystem, and therefore our findings may not directly generalize to other specification languages and programming languages. Lastly, our evaluation relies on Frama-C/WP to assess specification correctness and strength. The verification tool is inherently incomplete, and a valid specification may fail to be proved due to limitations of the underlying solver, leading to potential false negatives in our evaluation. Nevertheless, we employ the same Frama-C/WP version, verification configuration, and underlying solver environment across all experiments and baselines, ensuring the consistency and fairness of the comparisons.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based Agent for Software Engineering. Recent advances in LLMs have shifted software engineering automation from mere LLM queries toward autonomous agents that iteratively interact with software environments. Early efforts such as MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) and ChatDev ( Qian et al., 2024 ) focus on code generation by organizing software development as collaboration among role-specialized agents through predefined workflows for design, coding, and testing. As agentic capabilities evolve, recent works extend to repository-level tasks involving existing software. SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) addresses real-world GitHub issues by enabling agents to navigate repositories, edit files, and execute tests through a specialized interface. AutoCodeRover ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) incorporates program structures and iterative code search for issue localization and program repair. RepairAgent ( Bouzenia et al., 2025 ) enables autonomous defect repair by allowing LLMs to gather information, generate patches, invoke validation tools, and adapt actions based on feedback. OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025a ) further explores general-purpose software engineering agents that interact with code, command-line tools, and development environments. Despite this progress, agentic approaches for formal methods remain relatively nascent. Tu et al. ( Tu et al., 2026 ) introduce AutoRocq, an LLM agent that performs program verification in the Rocq prover by iteratively refining proofs based on prover feedback. Sun et al. ( Sun et al., 2026 ) employ LLM agents to orchestrate model checking tasks by selecting strategies, analyzing counterexamples, and refining decisions based on checker feedback. Compared to these works, SpecAgent treats formal specification synthesis as the primary task, perform agentic generation, repair, and refinement on formal specifications.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based Program Specification Synthesis. The emergence of LLMs has enabled specification synthesis beyond conventional rule-based and analysis-based approaches. AutoSpec ( Wen et al., 2024 ) pioneers LLM-based specification generation by leveraging static analysis to expose program hierarchies and guide synthesis. SpecGen ( Ma et al., 2024 ) combines conversational generation with heuristic mutation operators to repair generated specifications, while Preguss ( Wang et al., 2025b ) employs abstract interpretation to detect potential runtime errors and guide generation. SpecSyn ( Ma et al., 2026 ) further utilizes non-equivalent program mutations to assess and refine the semantic strength of generated specifications. Pei et al. ( Pei et al., 2023 ) and Cao et al. ( Cao et al., 2025 ) improve specification generation by fine-tuning LLMs on specification-related corpora. Compared to these works, SpecAgent reformulates specification synthesis as an agentic decision-making process, where specialized agents dynamically determine generation, repair, and refinement actions based on evolving context. Other works ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) target different specification languages, such as Verus for Rust. Due to substantial differences in programming languages and formal verification ecosystems, we do not directly compare SpecAgent with these approaches. Among them, StarVerus ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , a concurrent work, explores autonomous agents for synthesizing and repairing formal specifications using verifier feedback. However, its primary objective is to obtain specifications that pass verification, without explicitly critiquing their strength. In contrast, SpecAgent treats specification correctness as a prerequisite rather than the endpoint, explicitly identifying semantic deficiencies in the specifications and refining them when necessary.

paragraphs.en: We present SpecAgent , an agentic framework for automated ACSL specification synthesis that reformulates specification generation as an iterative decision-making process. By integrating planning, generation, verification-guided repair, and critique-guided refinement, SpecAgent identifies and revisits specification dependencies rather than following a fixed forward-only workflow. Extensive evaluation on real-world specification generation and verification tasks demonstrates that SpecAgent improves specification completeness while maintaining high precision, effectively supporting practical software verification. These results highlight the potential of agentic approaches for reliable and scalable formal specification synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SpecAgent，这是一个用于自动化 ACSL 规范合成的智能体框架，它将规范生成重新定义为一种迭代决策过程。 通过整合规划、生成、验证引导的修复以及批判引导的优化，SpecAgent 能够识别并重新审视规范之间的依赖关系，而不是遵循固定的单向工作流程。 在真实世界的规范生成与验证任务中进行的大量评估表明，SpecAgent 在保持高精确度的同时提升了规范的完整性，从而有效支持了实际的软件验证工作。 这些结果凸显了智能体方法在实现可靠且可扩展的形式化规范合成方面的潜力。
